subject.title: [Security] Path traversal validation bypass in secret-file.ts with relative path injections

question: Can any untrusted plugin configuration, remote request, or agent-controlled launcher set ACP’s --token-file or --password-file process arguments on current main?
rationale: Whether this is a vulnerability depends on the caller trust boundary, not lexical decoding alone; security owners must confirm the intended operator-controlled path contract and any indirect launch surfaces.

options.title: Confirm trusted local boundary
options.body: Document that these flags are local operator inputs, verify direct-file and symlink protections, and close the report unless an untrusted argument source is demonstrated.

options.title: Prove and harden an untrusted launcher
options.body: If an untrusted surface controls these arguments, constrain that launcher to an explicit credential root and add a regression test for the demonstrated path.

recommendation.title: Confirm trusted local boundary
recommendation.body: Document that these flags are local operator inputs, verify direct-file and symlink protections, and close the report unless an untrusted argument source is demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is connected to current secret-management contracts and was explicitly routed the issue in the live timeline.
